glob.week: Latest GPEI update (18 Nov 2026): 9 new cVDPV cases (Chad 4 cVDPV2, Nigeria 2 cVDPV3, Syria 3 cVDPV1), no new WPV1 case. 7 environmental detections: WPV1 in Pakistan 2 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Sindh), cVDPV2 in Israel 1 and Somalia 3, cVDPV3 in Nigeria 1. Syria: 3 cVDPV1 cases confirmed in Deir Ezzor (al-Mayadin, Dhiban), latest confirmed 12 Nov; the Ministry of Health plans a governorate-wide campaign for 371,000 children under five from 30 Nov.
glob.wpvnote: Pakistan: 10 cases in 2026, 31 in all of 2025. The 10th case (Karak, S.G. Khel, 14-month-old girl) was announced by the NEOC on 25 Nov 2026 and is added here ahead of the GPEI update. Afghanistan and global totals may be higher now.
